events.title: The Biggest AI Talent Challenge Is Resilience, Not Speed
events.summary: Engineering leaders should build highly adaptable, vendor-agnostic infrastructure instead of relying on expensive, unpredictable proprietary hyperscalers, advises guest columnist Sumeet Vaidya, who says the foundational flexibility allows enterprises to safely pair AI agents with human teams while seamlessly switching between top-tier and cost-free open-source models as the industry evolves.
events.summary_zh: 专栏作者 Sumeet Vaidya 建议工程负责人建设高度适应性、与供应商无关的基础设施，而不是依赖昂贵且不可预测的专有超大规模云厂商，以便企业安全地将 AI agent 与人类团队结合，并在顶级模型和免费开源模型之间灵活切换。

events.title: Building the enterprise environment for agentic AI
events.summary: For the enterprise, the promise of agentic AI is much more than just a better chatbot. It is software agents that execute business tasks end-to-end across people, business workflows, data, and systems. The platform best-suited to run agents is built with proper CPU capacity, resilient data access, policy-aware tool use, observability, memory management, and the…
events.summary_zh: 对企业而言，agentic AI 不只是更好的聊天机器人，还包括能够跨越人员、业务流程、数据和系统端到端执行任务的软件 agent。适合运行这类 agent 的平台需要具备充足的 CPU 容量、韧性数据访问、支持策略的工具调用、可观测性、记忆管理等能力。
events.subject: MIT Technology Review
